summary: Presence analytics now derives an hour-of-week occupancy profile and a typical arrival/departure time for every subject's confirmed home/work place, plus a fail-closed anomaly score (robust z-score against that subject's own history) on how long a stay lasted. Only applies to a place that already crossed the home/work threshold — an unlabeled cluster never gets rhythm data.
details: presence_stays.place_id, present in the schema since Tier 2 but never written, is now wired: a closed stay inside an existing home/work place is linked to it, and past stays that predate a place's first creation are backfilled once.
New script scripts/revalidate_stay_params.py — an operator tool to re-check stay_radius_m/stay_min_dwell_seconds (design/27 §7.1's flagged-unmeasured defaults) against the live corpus.
limitations: Anomaly scoring needs anomaly_min_samples (default 5) prior stays at a place before it will say anything — fail-closed, not a bug.

The first-place backfill only applies to a home/work place created after this deploys — a subject who already has a labelled home or work place before this ships starts their rhythm and anomaly history from zero, not from that existing place's past stays. Their history builds from the stays that close after the deploy.
Tier 5 (routes/corridors, the other half of issue #6) is a separate, not-yet-written plan.
